_comment: Targets for scripts/icon-ink.mjs. Every number here is the INTENDED ink size, in CSS
pixels, on the glyph's long axis. It is a decision, not a measurement: the measurement
is what the script prints, and the gap between the two is the bug.
defaultWant applies to any glyph without its own entry. Give a glyph its own entry only
when it genuinely should read a different size from its neighbours, and say why.
